summary: Tested the 'Release to client for review' feature on the backend (pytest, 17/17 core tests pass, plus 2 new leak tests that fail) and the frontend (Playwright at 390x844 and 1920x1080). What works: internal status vs client_status are kept apart on GET case, /mine and /status. Admin status changes email only the admin, never the client. The preview endpoint returns all fields, and the default email has no em/en dashes. Silent release, Release now and schedule all work. A scheduled release fired with the snapshot status: scheduled Ready for Payment, internal changed to Completed, client got Ready for Payment, history mode=scheduled. Past or bad times return 400. The changed_since_scheduled list, update and cancel work. The held draft and explainer are hidden until release. The review ack uses the released status. The 3 old endpoints return 404. The old buttons are gone. UI: the release bar, dialog, all 3 modes, schedule date/time, editable subject/message, empty-day and empty-subject toasts, scheduled notice, changed warning, Update and Cancel all work on mobile and desktop. Found 2 backend data leaks to the client, 1 automatic client email that is still on, and a 4px horizontal overflow on mobile.

critical.issue: _client_view does not remove `scheduled_release`. The client JSON shows snapshot.status (the INTERNAL status, e.g. 'Drafting Trust'), the future email subject and message, created_by (admin email) and the release time. `release_history` (admin emails, subjects) is also returned to the client. This breaks the rule that the client sees only the released status. Repro: tests/test_iteration33_release_to_client.py::TestClientLeak::test_no_scheduled_or_history_leak

asset_items[].pending_admin (held admin asset edits) appears in the client case JSON before release. /asset-items correctly shows the old value, but the raw case doc leaks the held edit. Repro: TestClientLeak::test_no_pending_admin_leak. Fix: in _client_view, strip pending_admin from each asset item and drop scheduled_release and release_history.

Still sends an automatic client email 'Your trust is ready' (status Ready for Payment) via send_email_notification (server.py ~line 5382). This breaks the owner rule that only the Release button emails clients. It should use _client_auto_email_off or be removed.

minor.issue: A welcome email still goes to the client automatically (server.py ~2677). It is triggered by the client's own signup, so it may be intended. Owner should confirm.

minor.endpoint: POST /admin/trust-cases/{id}/send-review-reminder, admin case message to client (~3366), admin reply to client question (~3537)
minor.issue: These are manual admin actions that still email the client directly, outside the Release button. Probably intended. Confirm with the owner.
release_at is parsed with replace(tzinfo=NY). Times that do not exist or happen twice on DST change days are not handled. Edge case only.

ui_bugs.issue: The bar uses -mx-4 (16px) but the page gutter is 12px. The bar spans x=-4 to 394, so document.scrollWidth is 394 at 390px and the page scrolls sideways. Use -mx-3, or match the container padding.
admin-status-select is 38px tall, below the 44px tap target. Use min-h-[44px].

design_issues.screen: Admin case page mobile, with a scheduled release and changed warning
issues: The sticky bar grows to about 380px of the 844px viewport (notice, warning, 2 buttons, status and the main button) and covers a lot of content. Consider making the notice collapsible.
Update scheduled release (btn-accent) has white text on a light bronze background, which is low contrast.
Schedule mode has no option to schedule without an email in the UI. The API supports send_email:false, but the dialog always schedules with email.
Uses the browser's native date/time inputs, not the shadcn Calendar. This is OK on phones, but it is not consistent with the rest of the app.

design_issues.screen: Admin header mobile (from before this work)
issues: Nav links (nav-admin-*), logout and the change-email, temp-password and view-as links are 16-36px tall, below 44px.

action_items: In _client_view, strip scheduled_release, release_history and asset_items[].pending_admin (and any other admin-only fields) from client responses
send-for-signing: stop the automatic 'Your trust is ready' client email (route it to _client_auto_email_off)
ReleaseBar: fix the 4px horizontal overflow at 390px (-mx-4 vs 12px page gutter)
Optional: add an email on/off choice to schedule mode, and fix the contrast of the Update scheduled release button
critical_code_review_comments: _client_view only replaces status and hides the draft. It has no allow-list, so any new admin-only field on trust_cases leaks to clients. Use an explicit deny/allow list.
_apply_release reads the case and then writes it with $set asset_items (whole array). A client asset edit made at the same moment can be overwritten (race). Consider per-item positional updates.
admin_update_scheduled_release only regenerates the message if it equals the old default. This is fine, but the subject is never regenerated.
server.py is 7000+ lines. The release logic should move to its own module.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work, only overflow and tap-target issues)

seed_data_creation: Created about 6 TEST client accounts and cases with test_release_*@example.com emails via register plus POST /trust-cases. Deleted the scheduled-fire case 67a00afd by id. The others remain because their ids were not tracked. Changed the status of the provided test case ed21262e (Rita Release) and released it several times; it is now internal and client Ready for Client Review, with no schedule.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iteration33_release_to_client.py -p no:randomly. TestClientLeak should pass after the fix. The scheduled-fire check (manual_iter33_scheduled_fire.py) takes about 4 minutes; run it with python -u in the background. Resend rejects @example.com, so emailed=false is expected. Admin status changes log no 'suppressed' line because _notify_status_change simply has no client branch.
rca of the issue: Leaks: _client_view (server.py ~959) returns {**case, status: client_status} after _hide_unreleased_draft. That only removes trust_draft, trust_page_explanations and trust_page_job, so scheduled_release (whose snapshot holds the internal status), release_history and asset_items.pending_admin all go to the client. Email: send-for-signing still calls send_email_notification to client_email directly. It was missed in the _client_auto_email_off sweep.
